newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal 1998 budget plans normal, says minister.
newsitem.headline: Portugal 1998 budget plans normal, says minister.

text.p: Preparations for Portugal's 1998 budget are proceeding normally despite the government's threat to resign after opposition parties rejected a government bill on local government spending plans, a minister said on Friday.
"The terms and conditions for the preparation of the budget are proceeding normally. There are no reasons to delay the budget," Jorge Coelho, Assistant Minister to the Prime Minister, told TSF radio.

Socialist Prime Minister Antonio Guterres said on Thursday night his government would quit if parliament pushed through a bill on local government spending that would harm Portugal's chances of joining the European single currency.
In a parliamentary vote on Thursday, opposition parties cast 109 votes to reject the government bill on local government spending against 102 in favour.
The government must present its 1998 budget proposals to parliament by October 15 this year.
